name: Outlook
description: Connect Hotmail / Outlook.com / Live to search, read, list nested folders, move by folder name, draft, send, and delete mail. Sending, deleting, and moving require explicit user intent.
whenToUse: Use this plugin to search, read, move into nested folders, list folders, draft, send, or delete Hotmail / Outlook.com mail. Connect an account on the plugin details page first.

outlook_accounts.description: List Outlook / Hotmail accounts connected to this plugin and their status.

outlook.description: Run Outlook mail operations including list_folders with nested path/id and move by folder name, path, or id. Sending, deleting, and moving require explicit user intent.
